meta.goal: Build the product through a dev-first workflow, completing configurable deal rules, lifecycle automation, billing, and uploads before public soft launch.
meta.summary: As of 2026-10-14, dev.gigs.ge and uat.gigs.ge are live with separate Cloud Run services and databases, and both passed the six-point smoke check. New work goes to dev, then is promoted to main/UAT. The core happy path exists, but business rules are partly hard-coded and automation is missing: fee ledger/invoices, contract timers, disputes/evidence/arbitration, admin management UI, uploads, and server-side contact visibility. Product decision: postpone tester guides and FAQ; they are not launch-development blockers. Active slice: admin-managed platform settings, audit history, and immutable policy snapshots for new contracts; later timer and billing slices must consume those snapshots.

milestones.exitCriteria: Dev and UAT Cloud Run environments are live on their custom domains, have separate databases, and pass the six-point smoke check; branch promotion policy is documented.

milestones.exitCriteria: Stakeholder feedback collected and triaged; blocking bugs fixed; docs cleanup plan executed.

milestones.exitCriteria: Configurable platform settings store live; BullMQ timers (48h auto-complete, 14d overdue, 7d dispute auto-resolve) reading from settings; dispute evidence + arbiter resolution working; minimal admin panel (settings editor + dispute queue); contact visibility enforced server-side.

milestones.name: Money & media
milestones.exitCriteria: Configurable fee split applied on completion; billing ledger; monthly invoices with sub-1-GEL carry-over; invoice viewer; R2 uploads with EXIF stripping and MIME validation.

milestones.name: Launch hardening
milestones.exitCriteria: Real email/SMS provider; gig search/filter/pagination; profile editing; reviews; e2e tests; CI smoke gate; Georgian i18n; PWA; error logging.

milestones.name: Public soft launch
milestones.exitCriteria: Go/no-go review passed; launch plan executed.

engineering.task: Add platform settings storage, an admin-only read/update API, change audit history, and contract policy snapshots; wire grace-period checks to the saved contract snapshot.
engineering.notes: Backend slice implemented and tested per docs/specs/feat-configurable-contract-settings.md. Defaults: poster fee 3%, worker fee 2%, cancellation grace 24h, completion response 48h, overdue completion 14d, arbiter unlock 24h, dispute auto-resolution 7d. New settings apply when the second party signs; existing contracts are unchanged. The admin settings UI/deployment and timer/billing integrations remain separate M2/M3 work.

engineering.task: Implement BullMQ background workers for contract timers: 48h auto-complete, 14-day overdue auto-complete, 7-day dispute auto-resolve — all reading timeframes from platform_settings.
Implement dispute evidence submission endpoints and arbiter resolution API (schema already exists: disputeEvidence, disputeEvidenceFiles, arbiterDecision fields).
Enforce contact-info and field visibility rules server-side in API responses (visContact etc. exist in schema but are not enforced).
Build and deploy the minimal admin app: secure first-admin setup, admin login, platform settings editor, and dispute queue with arbiter resolution UI.
engineering.notes: apps/admin is currently a placeholder. First-admin setup must be restricted to an owner-controlled operation, never public self-registration. Deploy to dev first, then UAT, and configure API CORS and admin subdomains before remote use. Analytics/moderation dashboards come post-launch.
